data.one_liner: A development-time macro system for instant code generation without build_runner.
data.what_it_does: Macro Kit provides an analyzer-plugin-based macro system that generates code instantly on save in under 100ms. It includes built-in macros for data classes, compile-time computation, asset paths, shader reloading, and embedding files.
use_when: You want fast code generation without the overhead of build_runner
You need to generate data classes, asset paths, or embed files directly in Dart
avoid_when: You rely strictly on standard official Dart macros which have different APIs
You are targeting environments where analyzer plugins cannot be set up
strengths: Generates code in under 100ms after initial run
Eliminates slow build processes and build_runner conflicts
Allows real-time debugging of macros inside your app
weaknesses: Macros are currently limited to classes, top-level functions, records, and top-level variables
Requires manual setup of an analysis_options plugin and a macro_context file
data.setup_notes: Requires activating the global tool, configuring plugins in analysis_options.yaml, and creating a macro_context.dart file.

alternatives.name: build
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard build system infrastructure over custom development-time macro servers.

alternatives.name: build_runner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a battle-tested and widely adopted code generation framework across the Dart ecosystem.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want mature union types and immutable data classes via build_runner.
